split_rule: Preserve source test; SHA256(seed:object_id) order source train: first150 calibration, next50 validation, remaining train.
group_unit: Source physical object directory; no verified purchase/cooking batch IDs available.
input_rule: Single provided 224x224 RGB per object. Ignore point cloud, depth, volume, filenames and labels as model inputs.
label_origin: Published measured mass times FNDDS nutrient density; not lab assays or model-generated pseudo labels.
quality_policy: Reject invalid/nonfinite/negative required values and invalid RGB. Flag plausibility without rewriting labels. No model-error-based filtering.
release_gate: Import audit and visual duplicate review must pass before use. Exact old/new duplicates block release.
usage: Only train/validation available for development. Reserve cal for frozen model threshold and test for one final evaluation. Metadata integrity audits are not performance evaluation.
